facts.text: This is the reservations team at Nopa, a restaurant where Mia books dinners for groups of friends.

evidence.quote: Hi Nopa Team,

facts.text: Mia books under the name Mia Song.

evidence.quote: Full name: Mia Song

facts.text: December 2024: Mia booked a holiday dinner for 6 for Friday, December 20. She asked for 7:00 PM and got the window table at 7:15 PM.

evidence.quote: 7:15 PM on Friday, December 20 is perfect for 6 adults

facts.text: Mia likes the long table near the window for larger groups.

evidence.quote: Is the long table near the window available?

facts.text: Bookings for 6 needed a card on file, and Mia added one.

evidence.quote: I've added the card on file

facts.text: For the December dinner, Mia asked whether she could bring her own bottle of wine and what the corkage fee was.

evidence.quote: Could we bring one bottle of our own

facts.text: For the December dinner, Mia asked whether the group could be seated before everyone arrived, because one friend would be late.

evidence.quote: One friend may arrive around 7:30 PM

facts.text: June 2025: Mia booked a birthday dinner for a friend on Saturday, June 14. She asked for 7:30 PM and took the 6:45 PM table in the back room.

evidence.quote: small birthday dinner for a friend
The 6:45 PM table in the back room works for us

facts.text: Mia prefers a table away from the bar for intimate dinners.

evidence.quote: a table away from the bar would be ideal

facts.text: The June 14 party grew from 4 to 5 adults, and Mia asked the kitchen to put a candle on one dessert.

evidence.quote: We are now 5 adults instead of 4
put a candle on one dessert

facts.text: Saturday bookings needed a card hold, and Mia added it through the link.

evidence.quote: I've added the card hold through the link

facts.text: September 2026: Mia booked a group dinner for 8 adults on Friday, September 25 at 7:00 PM, with the family-style menu.

evidence.quote: Please go ahead and book the family-style menu.

facts.text: Before confirming the group of 8, Mia asked about the set menu price, the deposit and the cancellation window. She said she would pay the deposit through the link that day.

evidence.quote: what is the cancellation window?
I'll complete the deposit through the link today.

facts.text: Mia's follow-up emails usually list numbered questions, such as wine, arrival, party size and dessert.
